purpose: Defines the evaluation task models, execution driver interfaces, pluggable harness adapters, and hermetic CoW sandbox environments for Prism.
scope: Covers crates/prism-core: TaskSpec, VcrCassette, ExecutionDriver trait, HarnessAdapter trait, ClaudeCliDriver, AgyCliDriver, OpenAiCompatibleDriver, OpenCodeDriver, VcrReplayDriver, WorkspaceSandbox with Reflink/APFS CoW and POSIX setpgid process group reaping.
non_goals: Assertion evaluation logic or grading rules (delegated to prism-grader).
CLI argument parsing or terminal table rendering (delegated to prism-cli).

api_surface.name: TaskSpec
api_surface.signature: pub struct TaskSpec { pub id: CompactString, pub skill: CompactString, pub input_prompt: String, pub fixture_repo: Option<PathBuf>, pub expected_assertions: Vec<CompactString>, pub max_turns: usize, pub timeout_seconds: u64 }
api_surface.description: Evaluation task definition containing the input prompt, private fixture repository path, expected assertions, and turn limits.

api_surface.name: ExecutionDriver
api_surface.signature: pub trait ExecutionDriver: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn is_available(&self) -> bool; async fn execute(&self, task: &TaskSpec, sandbox_dir: &std::path::Path) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript, PrismCoreError>; }
api_surface.description: Pluggable driver interface implemented by ClaudeCliDriver, AgyCliDriver, OpenAiCompatibleDriver, OpenCodeDriver, and VcrReplayDriver.
error_conditions: PrismCoreError::DriverUnavailable if required binary or API key is absent
PrismCoreError::CassetteNotFound if VCR cassette does not exist
PrismCoreError::ProcessFailed if subprocess execution exits with error

api_surface.name: OpenAiCompatibleDriver
api_surface.signature: pub struct OpenAiCompatibleDriver { pub base_url: CompactString, pub model_name: CompactString, pub api_key_env: CompactString }; impl OpenAiCompatibleDriver { pub fn qwen_coder(model: &str) -> Self; pub fn kimi(model: &str) -> Self; pub fn glm(model: &str) -> Self; pub fn gemini(model: &str) -> Self; }
api_surface.description: Generic streaming driver for any OpenAI-compatible API or local server (Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Gemini, DeepSeek, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio).

api_surface.name: OpenCodeDriver
api_surface.signature: pub struct OpenCodeDriver { pub binary_path: CompactString, pub model_name: CompactString }
api_surface.description: Headless CLI driver for executing tasks inside OpenCode / OpenHands environments.

api_surface.name: WorkspaceSandbox
api_surface.signature: pub struct WorkspaceSandbox { _temp_dir: tempfile::TempDir, pub path: std::path::PathBuf }; impl WorkspaceSandbox { pub fn new(fixture_path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Self, std::io::Error>; pub async fn git_checkout(&self, commit_sha: &str) -> Result<(), std::io::Error>; pub async fn apply_patch(&self, patch: &str) -> Result<(), std::io::Error>; pub async fn run_test_suite(&self) -> Result<bool, std::io::Error>; }
api_surface.description: Hermetic file sandbox creating isolated /tmp/ workspace clones with Reflink/APFS Copy-on-Write cloning and POSIX process group tree reaping on timeout.
error_conditions: std::io::Error if disk space is exhausted or file copying fails

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN WorkspaceSandbox is initialized with a fixture path, THE SYSTEM SHALL clone the fixture files into a temporary /tmp/ directory using Reflink/APFS Copy-on-Write and initialize a clean git repository.
WHEN WorkspaceSandbox drops out of scope or times out, THE SYSTEM SHALL terminate all child processes in the POSIX process group (setpgid) and delete the temporary directory automatically.
WHEN VcrReplayDriver executes with matching cassette, THE SYSTEM SHALL deserialize the CanonicalTranscript and return in under 5 milliseconds with $0.00 network spend.
WHEN ClaudeCliDriver executes, THE SYSTEM SHALL invoke the local claude CLI using -p and --output-format=json in non-interactive mode.
WHEN OpenAiCompatibleDriver executes, THE SYSTEM SHALL dispatch standard /v1/chat/completions payload with Bearer authentication and parse response tokens via CodexAdapter.
WHEN OpenCodeDriver executes, THE SYSTEM SHALL invoke the opencode binary with run --task and --json flags.
IF an offline task cannot locate a matching cassette file, THE SYSTEM SHALL return PrismCoreError::CassetteNotFound with the expected cassette path.

reasoning: Establishes evaluation task structures, multi-model execution drivers (Claude, AGY, OpenAI-compatible, OpenCode), and hermetic CoW sandboxing.
